reviewed_passages.title: A Tool to Combine Expert Knowledge and Machine Learning for Defect Detection and Root Cause Analysis in a Hot Strip Mill
reviewed_passages.text: Latham and Giannetti describe a tool combining expert knowledge with machine learning to detect and investigate width-related defects in hot rolling. Their abstract reports training and validation with data from an operating mill. This is a general research reference, not a record of the current investigation, and it does not supply diagnostic test costs or outcome likelihoods for this application.
